messages: meera: Quick note from design review: the help sidecar uses "variant" in headings but the model picker shows "model version". Users keep asking which to pick in demos. Can we standardize? cc @gavin @sophia gavin: Echo. Product prefers "model version" for release semantics. Ops team uses "variant" for runtime configs (int8, fp16). We should make the console consistent and surface the other term parenthetically. sophia: UX approach: show primary label = "Model version". When a runtime option is relevant, show it as "v3 (int8 variant)" and add a small inline explainer with a "Why this matters" disclosure. ben: Accessibility bits: disclosures and tooltips need aria-expanded/aria-controls and role="tooltip" for the helper text. Also ensure focus returns to the originating control when sidecar closes. Example restore snippet I can PR: `const last = document.activeElement; openSidecar(); /* on close */ if (last) last.focus();` meera: Copy ask: change in-panel CTAs to "Open docs" and keep external links as "Learn more" so users know what to expect. Also add a tiny line in the sidecar: "Also referred to as "Reserved capacity" in billing docs" for the Dedicated page. gavin: Search alias request too: users search for "reserved", "reserved capacity", "dedicated pool". Let's add alias mappings in the help index so sidecar search returns the right doc. sophia: Design placement: crosslink to Routing > Fallbacks needs to be top-right of the sidecar header (label: "Related: routing & fallback"). Open in sidecar, not new tab. UX caution: fix focus trap before flipping many links. ben: Small code example for accessible tooltip: `Variant = runtime config (quantization, precision)` help-bot: Docs to reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/terminology and https://docs.redwood.ai/console/dedicated-vs-reserved please link both in the sidecar. meera: Action items: 1) gavin -> add alias table + help-index PR, 2) ben -> PR for focus restore + tooltip a11y, 3) sophia -> figma mock for crosslink + disclosure placement, 4) meera -> microcopy for parenthetical variant usage. We will validate in next design crit. :white_check_mark:
